scripts.audio: python3 audio/make_soundtrack.py && ffmpeg -v error -y -i public/audio/soundtrack.raw.wav -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a pcm_s16le public/audio/soundtrack.wav && rm public/audio/soundtrack.raw.wav
scripts.render: npm run audio && remotion render src/index.jsx FlowForgePromo out/flowforge-promo.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=320k
